name: prompt-library
description: Bibliothèque personnelle de prompts pour la création d'images

scripts.build: npm run validate && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.refresh: node scripts/import-excel.mts --auto && node scripts/optimize-images.mts && node scripts/normalize.mts && node scripts/merge.mts && node scripts/detect-duplicates.mts && node scripts/validate-library.mts --input=generated/merged.json && node scripts/generate-library.mts && node scripts/validate-library.mts
scripts.refresh:full: node scripts/import-excel.mts --full && node scripts/optimize-images.mts && node scripts/normalize.mts && node scripts/merge.mts && node scripts/detect-duplicates.mts && node scripts/validate-library.mts --input=generated/merged.json && node scripts/generate-library.mts && node scripts/validate-library.mts
